answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13944 Country: India Title: Some scholer says ishraq salah is 2 rakah and some says 4-rakah ,which is correct view? Question: Some scholer says ishraq salah is 2 rakah and some says 4-rakah ,which is correct view? Answer ID: 13944 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1012/1012=M/1430) The Salah of Ishraq is two rak?ah, there is no wrong if one performs it four rak?ah: عن أَنَسِ بن مَالِكٍ قال قال رسول اللَّهِ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم: من صلى الْغَدَاةَ في جَمَاعَةٍ ثُمَّ قَعَدَ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ حتى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ ثُمَّ صلى رَكْعَتَيْنِ كانت له كَأَجْرِ حَجَّةٍ وَعُمْرَةٍ، قال: قال رسول اللَّهِ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم: تَامَّةٍ تَامَّةٍ تَامَّةٍ (ترمذي) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
